en.name: Rice milk
en.summary: Rice milk is milled rice cooked with water, usually with an enzyme that breaks the starch down into sugars, then pressed and strained into a thin, faintly sweet drink. It is sold chilled or in shelf-stable cartons. Go by the use-by date on an unopened pack, and once it is opened use it within 7–10 days, refrigerated.
en.pantry: An unopened aseptic carton is fine in a cupboard until its printed date, because it was sterilised and filled on a sealed line. A carton sold from a chiller is not the same product and has to stay cold: the 2-hour rule applies to it, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Once either kind is open, the cupboard stops being an option. What makes rice milk especially unforgiving when it is left out is the sugar — the enzymes used in making it have already turned much of the starch into simple sugars, so a warm opened carton is a ready-made culture medium. It ferments rather than merely souring: expect fizz and a cidery smell.
en.fridge: 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on an inside shelf where the temperature is steady rather than in the door. Unopened chilled cartons run to the date printed on them; opened, you have 7–10 days with the cap on and the carton standing upright. Rice milk throws a sediment more than any other plant drink — a chalky white layer of starch settles out within hours, and that is entirely normal, so shake it before pouring and do not read it as spoilage. Judge the carton on smell and taste instead: sour, fizzy or thickened and it goes.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is published for rice milk, and freezing is a poor fit for it. Starch retrogrades when frozen — the molecules re-associate into crystalline regions — and the thawed drink comes back gritty and split in a way no amount of shaking repairs. If you must, use a container with headspace at −18 °C (0 °F) and plan to cook with it: porridge, pancakes, a smoothie, anywhere the grain will go unnoticed. Buying the smaller carton is usually the better answer.
en.thawing: In the fridge, never on the counter, then shake or blend it hard. Accept that the texture will be grainy and use it in cooking rather than pouring it into a glass. Do not refreeze it.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or yeasty smell rather than a faint sweet-cereal one.
A fizz or hiss on opening, or a swollen carton.
Ropy, slimy or gluey strands when you pour.
Mould around the spout or cap, or visible growth in the liquid.
tips: Shake hard before every pour; sediment is normal and misleads people.
Write the opening date on the carton.
Do not drink from the carton if you are keeping the rest.
Buy small cartons if you only use it occasionally.

faq.q: How long does rice milk last after opening?
faq.a: About 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept closed and upright.

faq.q: Does rice milk need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Chilled cartons do, and unopened ones go by the use-by date. Aseptic shelf-stable cartons can stay in the cupboard until opened.
There is no established timeline, and it thaws gritty because the starch retrogrades. Freeze it only for cooking, at −18 °C with headspace.

faq.q: Why is there a layer at the bottom of the carton?
faq.a: Rice starch settles. That is normal — shake it back in. Judge spoilage by smell and taste, not by sediment.

zh.name: 米漿（米奶）
zh.summary: 這裡的米漿指的是把米加水煮過、通常再用酵素把澱粉分解成糖，然後壓榨過濾而成、質地稀薄帶淡甜味的西式米奶，有冷藏與常溫利樂包兩種。未開封以包裝上的有效日期為準；開封後冷藏，請在 7～10 天內喝完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的無菌利樂包可以放在櫥櫃到標示日期，因為它經過滅菌並在密封產線上充填。從冷藏櫃拿的那一種不是同一個產品，必須全程保冷，適用 2 小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。兩種只要一開封，櫥櫃就不再是選項。米漿被放在外面時特別禁不起，關鍵在糖：製程中的酵素已經把大部分澱粉轉成簡單的糖，所以一盒開過又放溫的米漿等於現成的培養基。它是發酵，而不只是單純變酸——你會看到氣泡，聞到蘋果酒味。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下、溫度穩定的內側層架，不要放門邊。未開封的冷藏包裝以盒上的日期為準；開封後蓋好、盒身直立，7～10 天。米漿沉澱得比任何一種植物奶都多——幾個小時內底部就會積出一層粉白色的澱粉，那完全正常，倒之前搖勻就好，不要把它當成壞掉。判斷要靠氣味和味道：發酸、冒泡或變稠就丟掉。
zh.freezer: 米漿沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且冷凍很不適合它。澱粉一結凍就會老化回凝，分子重新排成結晶區，解凍後喝起來粗糙分離，再怎麼搖都救不回來。真的要凍，請用留有膨脹空間的容器放 −18 °C，並且打算拿去煮：粥、鬆餅、果昔，任何吃不出顆粒感的地方。買小包裝通常還是更好的答案。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面，之後用力搖勻或打勻。請接受它的質地會偏粗，拿去料理而不是倒進杯子裡。不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有酵母味，而不是淡淡的穀物甜香。
開封時冒泡或有嘶聲，或包裝鼓脹。
吸嘴或瓶蓋周圍長霉，或液體中看得到菌落。
tips: 每次倒之前用力搖；沉澱是正常的，但常被誤判。
還要留著喝的話，不要直接對著盒口喝。
偶爾才喝的話請買小包裝。

faq.q: 米漿開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊直立放 4 °C 以下，大約 7～10 天。
冷藏包裝一定要，未開封以有效日期為準。無菌常溫利樂包在開封前可放櫥櫃。
沒有既定期限，而且澱粉老化會讓它解凍後變粗糙。只建議冷凍後用於料理，放 −18 °C 並留膨脹空間。
是沉下去的米澱粉，正常現象，搖勻即可。判斷有沒有壞要靠氣味和味道，不是靠沉澱。
